|gr1= GUI Control - ListBox

|arg= local

|eff= local

|descr= Returns the text color of the item (right) with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user [[dialog]].

|s1= [[lbColorRight]] [idc, index]

|p1= idc: [[Number]] - control's id

|p2= index: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Color|Color (RGBA)]]

|s2= control [[lbColorRight]]  index

|p21= control: [[Control]]

|p22= index: [[Number]]

|r2= [[Color|Color (RGBA)]]

|x1= <sqf>_colour = lbColorRight [101, 0];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_color = _control lbColorRight 0;</sqf>
